name: VoiceStudio
description: Self-hosted voice synthesis and cloning studio. This helper installs the headless FastAPI server in an unprivileged Debian LXC; models are downloaded separately.

notes.text: Open http://<container-IP>:3900. The API key is stored in /opt/voicestudio_data/.env as OMNIVOICE_API_KEY.
Models are not downloaded automatically. Download them in VoiceStudio only after reviewing each model and dependency license.
Stable-release updates are checked daily at 03:30. Disable with systemctl disable --now voicestudio-update.timer.
CPU inference is slower. GPU passthrough and CUDA configuration are not automatic.

app_vars.name: var_voicestudio_hf_token
app_vars.label: Hugging Face Token (optional)
app_vars.help: Optional. Used for gated/private repositories and higher download limits; public models can be downloaded without it.
